common.base: latest remote dev at worker start
common.failure_policy: E2E failure writes a GAP report only; it must not create a repair task or mutate product/task state

tasks.title: Freeze and merge the code-derived L12 GAP, SD, and execution catalog
tasks.summary_zh: 獨立審查 PR #4832，重查 active task/PR/branch/worktree 與 #4834 overlap，合併唯一 execution catalog。
tasks.root_cause: Workers cannot safely execute an unmerged plan or replay historical L12 catalogs.
acceptance: 18 unique IDs and acyclic DAG validated

tasks.title: Make the existing source controller the durable scheduled owner
tasks.summary_zh: 正式長駐 source controller 與 bounded smoke 分離；不建立第二 scheduler。
tasks.root_cause: The same opt-in, restart=no, one-tick service is used as both production scheduler and smoke.
acceptance: existing controller supports durable unbounded reconcile
tasks.rollout: merge compatible domain code before integration activation
tasks.rollback: disable activation without adding a second owner

tasks.title: Persist canonical distillation terminal identity and Registry readback
tasks.summary_zh: 保存 strategy_id、registry_id、version/checksum；Registry readback 後才 terminal。
tasks.root_cause: The terminal receipt does not explicitly carry all canonical Registry identity fields.
tasks.rollback: stop enriched receipt without deleting drafts

tasks.title: Replace Alpha seed discovery with reviewed durable replication admission
tasks.summary_zh: 建立 ReplicationAdmission；未 review 不執行，seed 只保留 lineage。
tasks.root_cause: source_id is passed to a strategy_id route and seed discovery bypasses review admission.
acceptance: reviewed admission creates one terminal ExperimentRun
tasks.rollback: pause admission; never restore automatic seed discovery

tasks.title: Add Teaching terminal evaluation and conditional Consultation handoff
tasks.summary_zh: Teaching 保存 eval identity；需要 advisory 才建 ConsultRequest，不能寫 ConsultMemo。
tasks.root_cause: Teaching has no governed optional downstream receipt and must not become a memo authority.
validation: contract test against Consultation request schema
tasks.rollout: adapter remains retryable until Consultation is active
tasks.rollback: pause optional handoff and retain eval

tasks.title: Make Agora handoff and ack the single policy-learning intake path
tasks.summary_zh: pending handoff→policy readback→Agora ack；direct DB scanner 退出 production enqueue。
tasks.root_cause: Durable handoff/ack and cross-schema scanning are competing enqueue authorities.
acceptance: direct scanner cannot enqueue in production
tasks.rollback: select one path only; never enable both

tasks.title: Handoff imitation candidates to the existing Research experiment authority
tasks.summary_zh: processed candidate durable handoff 到 ExperimentTask/Run；Policy-learning 維持 promote=409。
tasks.root_cause: A terminal candidate has no production ExperimentTask producer or receipt.
acceptance: runtime effect remains none before approval
tasks.rollout: outbox can wait safely for Research activation

tasks.title: Use one Consultation workflow with a real in-stack contribution provider
tasks.summary_zh: special intake 只建 request；generic workflow 經 Consultation 專用 adapter 產 qualified memo。
tasks.root_cause: The real workflow is unconfigured while a special intake fabricates an approved memo.
tasks.rollout: merge provider route before integration env wiring
tasks.rollback: leave requests blocked; never restore fake approval

tasks.title: Validate and align Consultation approval through RuntimeBinding identity
tasks.summary_zh: validation-first 證明 approved artifact→explicit paper deploy→Plan/Binding；只修真 mismatch。
tasks.root_cause: The path exists but has no real proof against the frozen Consultation/Approval identity contract.
acceptance: approved immutable artifact creates Plan and active paper Binding

tasks.title: Execute the active RuntimeBinding artifact in the default paper signal producer
tasks.summary_zh: default paper decision 執行 pinned artifact；固定 AAPL BUY 只留 explicit smoke。
tasks.root_cause: The producer carries artifact identity but always executes BoundedPaperStrategy.
acceptance: different artifacts can yield different decisions
tasks.rollout: land adapter before integration default switch
tasks.rollback: explicit smoke diagnostic only; no hosted silent fallback

tasks.title: Prove real paper runtime telemetry through reconciliation terminal readback
tasks.summary_zh: validation-first 接真 paper event 到 DriftReport/IncidentCase；相容就不加無用 code。
tasks.root_cause: Existing tests do not prove the production paper-runtime event/correlation contract.
validation: frozen event contract test can run in parallel
tasks.rollback: revert fix and retain replayable events

tasks.title: Deliver Postmortems through one authenticated Evolution client
tasks.summary_zh: 共用 EvolutionClient 補 bearer、tenant、idempotency、target readback；不重做 auth。
tasks.root_cause: Postmortem outbox omits bearer and tenant required by Evolution token mode.
tasks.rollout: merge client before integration env wiring

tasks.title: Use typed exact BFF health targets and durable incident receipts
tasks.summary_zh: 每 target 明示 exact health path；驗 fail→telemetry receipt→incident→recovery。
tasks.root_cause: Universal /__health__ guessing and missing delivery identity create false degradation and blocked outboxes.
tasks.rollout: merge typed parser before integration registry/env

tasks.title: Integrate compose activation, twelve owner observations, catalog, and BFF truth
tasks.summary_zh: 唯一 shared owner 一次收斂 compose delta、12 natural-owner observations、catalog 與 fixed 12-row BFF truth。
tasks.root_cause: Shared activation and truth files would conflict if all domain workers edited them in parallel.
tasks.rollback: revert activation/catalog while retaining domain code

tasks.title: Show strict-live twelve-loop truth and explicit errors in execute-plans
tasks.summary_zh: LoopsPage 不再 catch 成 []；成功固定 12 rows，失敗明確 error/degraded。
tasks.root_cause: Frontend converts BFF failure into a false zero-loop truth.
tasks.rollout: merge to execute-plans dev; no hosted switch yet
tasks.rollback: serve prior FE without seed truth

tasks.title: Build a non-repairing compose-bound twelve-loop verifier harness
tasks.summary_zh: 平行建立 12 case + correlated-chain harness；不得 mock product HTTP、不得 dispatch repair。
tasks.root_cause: The old verifier audits evidence directories and can write passed without executing loops.
acceptance: old verifier cannot claim product closure
tasks.rollout: merge harness before product integration completes
tasks.rollback: remove invocation only; never hide failures

tasks.title: Run the real twelve-loop and Management acceptance matrix
tasks.summary_zh: 對整合後 stack 執行 12 loop cases、correlated chain、Management success/error；失敗只出 GAP。
tasks.root_cause: Component tests cannot prove integrated closure.
acceptance: failure report is non-zero and non-mutating

tasks.title: Perform one bounded dev rollout and hosted twelve-loop closeout
tasks.summary_zh: E2E 通過後一次部署，驗 exact FE/BFF commits 與 12 loops + Management 13-row matrix。
tasks.root_cause: Merged commits and builds do not prove the hosted symlink serves the accepted FE/BFF pair.
tasks.rollout: one bounded current Pantheon-owned dev deployment
tasks.rollback: switch to previous accepted release and publish gap
